text.title: Text & Reasoning
text.description: Chat and vision models for entry, midrange and high-memory devices, plus local retrieval. Start with the essential selection or explore the full catalog.

llm.title: Language Models
llm.description: Offline LLM cores for Q-Brain chat, summaries, reasoning and tool flows.

vision.title: Vision & Multimodal
vision.description: Local VLM packs that pair a GGUF language model with mmproj vision artifacts for Q-Brain Vision.

embedding.title: Embeddings & Retrieval
embedding.description: Sentence embedding packs for semantic search, RAG, indexing and vault retrieval.

packs.name: Gemma 4 E2B (QAT Q4_0)
packs.description: Multilingual instruction model with quantization-aware training to preserve quality at 4-bit precision. This GGUF variant requires ample RAM; it is different from the smaller mobile-runtime export. Text input only in this pack.

packs.name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct (QAD Q4_0)
packs.description: Lightweight text model for summaries, rewriting and extraction. Direct answers without a thinking stage. Italian is not among its declared target languages. Quantization-aware distillation reduces the 4-bit quality loss. Commercial use is subject to the LFM license conditions.
packs.weightsLicense: LFM Open License v1.0 (conditional commercial use)

packs.name: Llama 3.2 1B (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Compact multilingual assistant for short conversations, summaries and simple instructions. A lightweight Llama option with modest memory requirements.

packs.name: Llama 3.2 3B (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Multilingual assistant for chat, writing and summaries. A balanced Llama option for devices with more memory than the 1B version requires.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 0.8B (Q4_K_M, text)
packs.description: Compact multilingual text model for short instructions and simple everyday tasks. A lightweight option with lower accuracy than the larger Qwen models; keep conversations short on devices with limited RAM.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 2B (Q4_K_M, text)
packs.description: Balanced multilingual assistant for everyday chat, summaries and writing, including Italian. Optional reasoning for more complex requests; uses less memory than the 4B version.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 4B (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Multilingual text model for conversation, summaries and reasoning. A larger alternative to the 0.8B and 2B variants, with higher memory and processing requirements. Direct answers are the mobile default.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 9B (Q4_K_M, text)
packs.description: Larger multilingual model for conversation, summaries and reasoning. High memory requirements make it suitable for devices with substantial RAM.

packs.name: Q-Brain DeepSeek R1 (8B Q3_K_M) [BETA]
packs.description: DeepSeek R1-0528 reasoning model distilled on Qwen3-8B. Balanced quality for 10-12 GB Android phones and tablets. Best reasoning-per-byte ratio for the DeepSeek R1 series on mobile. BETA: verify SHA256 before production use.

packs.name: Q-Brain DeepSeek R1 (8B UD-IQ2_M) [BETA]
packs.description: DeepSeek R1-0528 reasoning model distilled on Qwen3-8B. Ultra-compressed for 8 GB Android phones. Strong logical reasoning and coding with native think-mode. BETA: verify SHA256 before production use.

packs.name: Gemma 4 E4B (QAT Q4_0)
packs.description: Multilingual instruction model with quantization-aware training to preserve quality at 4-bit precision. This GGUF variant requires ample RAM; it is different from the smaller mobile-runtime export. Text input only in this pack.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Balanced (E2B Q3_K_M)
packs.description: Balanced Gemma 4 E2B profile for mid-range and upper mid-range Android devices. Better quality than Q3_K_S with moderate RAM usage.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Mobile (E2B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Recommended Gemma 4 E2B text-only profile for flagship Android phones. Strong multilingual reasoning, coding, summaries and local tool orchestration.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Plus (E2B Q4_K_S)
packs.description: Higher-quality Gemma 4 E2B profile for upper mid-range and flagship Android phones. Good compromise before Q4_K_M.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Pro (E4B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: High-quality Gemma 4 E4B profile for 12 GB+ Android devices, tablets and local desktop-class runtimes. Not recommended as the default phone model.

packs.name: Q-Brain Gemma 4 Safe (E2B Q3_K_S)
packs.description: Most compatible Gemma 4 E2B profile for Android phones. Lowest RAM pressure while keeping Gemma 4 reasoning, multilingual and tool-oriented behavior.

packs.name: LFM2.5 2.6B (QAD Q4_0)
packs.description: Multilingual reasoning model, including Italian, for summaries, extraction and document questions. Always reasons before answering, so responses can take longer. Native function calling is not enabled. Quantization-aware distillation reduces the 4-bit quality loss. Commercial use is subject to the LFM license conditions.
packs.weightsLicense: LFM Open License v1.0 (conditional commercial use)

packs.name: Q-Brain ARM Safe (Llama 3.2 1B Q4_0_4_4)
packs.description: Universal ARM fallback profile. Safe pick when you want maximum compatibility across Android chipsets.

packs.name: MiniCPM5 2B (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Compact Chinese and English text model. Direct answers are the mobile default. Native XML function calling is not enabled.

packs.name: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: General-purpose instruction model for conversation, rewriting and summaries. Requires a device with ample available memory.

packs.name: Q-Brain Analyst (Phi-4-mini Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Heavier English-first analyst profile for summaries, long documents and reasoning-heavy work on stronger devices.

packs.name: Q-Brain Lite (Qwen3 0.6B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Ultra-light multilingual offline assistant for low-RAM phones, fast prompts and emergency fallback.

packs.name: Q-Brain Mobile (Qwen3 1.7B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Balanced default for most Android phones in 2026. Strong multilingual chat, summaries and light agent workflows.

packs.name: Q-Brain Pro (Qwen3 4B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Higher-quality multilingual assistant for flagship devices. Best for richer chat, summarization and light local tool orchestration.

packs.name: Q-Brain Ultra (Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Optional flagship tier for 16 GB class devices and tablets. Stronger quality, but heavier thermally and in RAM.

packs.name: SmolLM2 360M (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Small English text model for short instructions and simple summaries. Low download size, with limited factual knowledge and reasoning ability.

packs.name: SmolLM3 3B (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Multilingual text model for conversation, summaries and reasoning. Direct answers are the mobile default; longer reasoning uses more output tokens.

packs.name: LFM2.5 VL 450M (Q4_K_M + Q8 projector)
packs.description: Compact model for describing a single image and answering visual questions. Best suited to simple scenes; small text and detailed OCR can be inaccurate. Commercial use is subject to the LFM license conditions.
packs.weightsLicense: LFM Open License v1.0 (conditional commercial use)

packs.name: Qwen3.5 2B Vision (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Paired GGUF language model and vision projector for single-image analysis. Image detail, language accuracy and latency depend on the model and device. Video/audio input is not enabled.

packs.name: Qwen3.5 4B Vision (Q4_K_M)
packs.description: Multilingual model for single-image analysis, visual questions and text in images. Requires substantial free memory; the 2B variant suits smaller devices. Video and audio input are not enabled.

packs.name: SmolVLM2 256M Vision (Q8_0)
packs.description: Compact paired Vision model for simple image questions. Limited fine-text OCR and multilingual accuracy; stronger models are available in Vision.

Recommended for private LAN/onion remote nodes instead of normal Android local execution.

Do not mix with current text-only Gemma packs. Requires explicit multimodal artifact validation.
